missing capability rejects before game launch
reject or remove inherited SMOKE environment
EN root migration excludes JA subtree
ANSI/MAX_PATH limitations and non-ASCII native paths

F07.name: undirected-spell

stopped-boundary timers/drag/hallucinated inventory without core resumption

rng_policy.same_build_replay: fresh recipe or fresh-process restore with process-lifetime seed/clock control, fixed display requests; verify both RNG entry states
rng_policy.cross_build_replay: CORE parity mandatory; DISP equality only with same sampling contract; paint invariance always mandatory
rng_policy.control_lifetime: before initialization through restore/play/exit; all seed requests and clock reads
rng_policy.seed_context: record has_strong_rngseed, provider, both-stream init/reseed attempts and seed request cursor; source semantics not inferred from one numeric seed
rng_policy.reseed: control and record initialization plus all reseed sites; bones early return skips trailing mklev reseeds; seed-only success is insufficient

baseline_policy.known_nonconformance: inventory itemImage/drag/signature timer and Qt equipment drawWorn consume DISP under hallucination
baseline_policy.raw_reference: preserve separate pre-fix observations; never count failed paint/replay as pass
baseline_policy.phase0: fix existing sampling/repaint violations under R6 contract before freezing accepted baseline; review and record display sampling change

save_matrix.artifact: frozen closed-profile template copied into a unique writable run root
save_matrix.loader: default core validation; no skip-sanity bypass; built-in conversion/revision uplift separately classified, never unchanged compatibility

profile_policy.manual: isolated storage/settings without SMOKE automation or seed overrides
profile_policy.instrumented: separate test build/profile; read-only observer; control all clock reads/timezone/DST and seed requests for full process lifetime; never inject RNG state
profile_policy.admission: require early profile capability before Qt/core initialization; missing support rejects before launch
profile_policy.existing_support: manual isolation and RNG observers remain unimplemented
